command: sudo -n bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; echo ===IDENTITY===; hostname; id -un; echo ===UNIT_STATE===; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainCode -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ActiveExitTimestamp -p InactiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecCondition --no-pager; echo ===STATUS===; systemctl status entityos-vm.service --no-pager -l || true; echo ===JOURNAL_LAST_BOOT===; journalctl -u entityos-vm.service -b --no-pager -n 120 -o short-iso || true; echo ===FAILED_UNITS===; systemctl --failed --no-pager || true; echo ===DONE==='
